claim_boundary: All frozen EXP019 object events are retained; no event is redetected or silently dropped.
Scene labels are joined by recorded ws_scene_event_id, not inferred from nearby timestamps.
NOT_ANNOTATION_CANDIDATE is a pipeline category, not an additional human adjudication.
Eligibility flags implement only the frozen whole-scene and development-exposure restrictions.
Whole-scene exclusion is event-level; mixed videos retain their eligible non-whole-scene events.
All whole-scene events remain in the table for separately specified sensitivity and negative-control analyses.
This step does not compute DI-v1, substitute legacy attributes for its components, or construct a split.
No SAM or gate inference, calibration, fresh DEV evaluation, or TEST evaluation is performed.
